name: Moss Hedgehog

images.observation: All 13 raw clips at six phases inspected in source/battle front/side head and body. Moss Hedgehog preserves its long cream muzzle, black nose, eyes, ears, blue headband and cheek outline. Dark triangular cheek bristles and underside shadows remain attached during turns; production lighting was used to resolve their contour. Arms, feet, gi and long green quills follow the torso through locomotion, jump, attack, recoil and death.

techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-46-techniques
techniques.observations: All 216 production-color frames actually inspected in six native paired sheets: nine equipped techniques, front/side, twelve times each. Earth strike/pulse/breaker, lightning pulse, open wound, expose, rally, protect and signature preserve the long muzzle, cream lower cheeks/chin, ears/headband and quills. The opposite-side companion view exposes a continuous chin and neck boundary through windup, strike and recovery; arms and legs stay attached to the moving torso.

limits: Local exact-hash review, no live delivery or authenticated modal claim. Quills and clothing naturally occlude rear neck and inner joints; exposed cheek/chin, neck boundary and limbs inspected in brighter production and opposite-side companion views. One fresh 216-frame battle companion technique capture, not source override or independent second timing capture. Original component provenance retained exactly.
